cases.title: Damaged grinder: identity and policy conflict
cases.situation: A customer requests an immediate refund for a damaged grinder and asks for a person. A read-only order lookup succeeded but returned no match for the supplied order ID. The latest policy is dated after the order; the older policy version must be checked for applicability. Local identity state is unverified. A scripted tool loop has a tool_use for lookup and has not yet received a matching tool_result.

choices.text: Issue refund using the newest policy and claim the request is resolved.
Complete the read-only tool protocol, clarify ID, preserve identity/policy guards and hand off to a person.
Retry the successful no-match lookup indefinitely with the same ID.

cases.transfer: The corrected order ID matches, identity is verified, but an exception remains outside policy. Decide whether refund may now be automatic.

transfer_choices.text: Yes, because identity and lookup are now clear.
No; keep the policy exception in a structured human handoff.

cases.title: Receipt batch: uncertain extraction and duplicate result
cases.situation: Two fictional receipts enter a night batch. One text line gives a total but no tax; the schema permits null tax. An output returns a syntactically valid total that disagrees with the text. Another custom_id occurs twice, and one provider result is absent. A high-confidence field is still semantically wrong. Decide sample, correlation and review before another batch.

choices.text: Accept the schema-valid output and infer the missing result from its neighbor.
Validate meaning against text, quarantine duplicate/missing IDs, fix a small sample and route unresolved fields to a person.
Set all nullable fields to zero and retry the whole batch automatically.

cases.transfer: A later image attachment replaces the text receipt, while the current pipeline only supports text. Choose the boundary.

transfer_choices.text: Pretend OCR happened because the JSON schema is the same.
Require a separate image extraction path or human transcription; mark this run unsupported.

cases.title: Policy research: dated conflict and partial delegate failure
cases.situation: A coordinator investigates a warranty claim. One delegate finds a dated policy that applies to the order; another finds a newer FAQ that disagrees but may target only future orders. The shipping delegate times out. The coordinator has not received its promised result. A source gap is discovered after the first two reports.

choices.text: State a complete answer based on the newest FAQ and omit the failed delegate.
Preserve sources, dates and partial failure; delegate the new gap with explicit context, then hand off if uncertainty remains.
Repeat all delegates in parallel without a scoped question or source dates.

cases.transfer: A valid dated policy now resolves applicability, but the shipping investigation still failed. Can the whole answer be marked complete?

transfer_choices.text: No; communicate supported policy finding and the remaining shipping gap separately.
Yes; one resolved issue makes the entire response complete.

cases.title: Developer recovery: changed rule and stale session
cases.situation: A developer resumes a long Claude Code session after another checkout changed the refund module. The scratchpad records an old line number. A personal MCP server has a tool name that overlaps a project server. The intended change is narrow and safety critical. First locate actual code and tests; do not trust the old summary as current source.

evidence.old_note: refund guard near line 48, saved before checkout
evidence.current_checkout: refund guard moved; uncommitted work exists

choices.text: Edit line 48 immediately, use whichever tool appears first and continue the stale session.
Inspect current source/tests and MCP scope; isolate exploration, plan a focused edit and verify with examples.
Delete the existing tests so the resumed session passes quickly.

cases.transfer: A second task is open-ended exploration unrelated to the safety patch. Choose session handling.

transfer_choices.text: Use a separate exploratory session or fork and retain the current patch facts.
Mix its unverified conclusions into the current patch summary.

cases.title: Independent review: CI partial failure and prior issue
cases.situation: A local review pass finds a refund unit mismatch. The integration pass emits a valid-looking findings JSON file, but the host turn failed. A previous issue is absent from the new report. The comments category has repeated false alarms; one reported confidence is .99. CI is read-only and has no model credentials.

evidence.local_pass: complete; refund unit issue at refund.py:2
evidence.integration_pass: process exit 0; terminal failed; final JSON present
evidence.prior: issue not_reobserved; no proof of fix
evidence.noise: comments high FP on small authored sample

choices.text: Publish the JSON as an empty successful review and close the prior issue.
Keep integration incomplete, retain the prior issue as unverified, use explicit criteria and quarantine noisy reports for human review.
Filter all findings below confidence .99 and call remaining reports correct.

cases.transfer: A future trusted workflow gets a model key. What is still needed before claiming an independent PR review?

transfer_choices.text: Observed fresh host invocation, terminal success, source-bound findings, actual test context and appropriate authorization.
Only a successful local parser unit test.

cases.title: Claude Code work rules in a changed shop project
cases.situation: The shop adds a new warranty script while the existing project has a shared CLAUDE.md, a path rule for receipts, and a reusable skill for policy source checks. A generated patch changes refund behavior. A unit test covers zero dollars only. The current request concerns warranty policy, not receipt extraction.

evidence.project_rule: CLAUDE.md lists test standards and fixture conventions
evidence.test: zero-only test does not expose nonzero unit bug

choices.text: Apply the receipt path rule to all files, accept the zero-only test and skip source search.
Use shared project rules and the relevant skill, keep scoped rules scoped, inspect source and add a nonzero example before trusting the patch.
Overwrite personal instructions and use one generic prompt for every file.

cases.transfer: The same one-off patch request will never repeat. Choose a reusable skill or direct focused instruction.

transfer_choices.text: Direct focused instruction and test; avoid creating a new reusable skill without recurrence.
Create a global skill that overrides all project rules.
